items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. Exact decision: block public exposure and security-sensitive releases, preserve private and parked launch gates, and permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, requeue unchanged work, or conduct external outreach.
